digital_conversion.contract: Upstream film exposure/development -> D50 fixed Gaussian RGB transmission; D=-log10(S/S_base), S=sum(D50*Gaussian*10^(-spectral_density)); q=0.184*10^((D-D_gray)/0.60), where D_gray is the same film at linear RGB 0.184; shared channel shoulder q/(0.816+q) -> upstream output gamut compression. No paper, per-film slope/matrix fit, image statistics or automatic exposure. Generic digital positive model; not a measured physical scanner.
digital_conversion.tone: q / (1 - grayLinearAnchor + q), identical per RGB channel
digital_conversion.baseRemoval: channel transmission divided by unexposed base transmission
digital_conversion.missingSpectralData: NaN transmission contributes zero, matching upstream density_to_light
digital_conversion.grayBalance: one fixed simulated gray per film; density offsets only

processingPath: film exposure -> film development -> Film Lab virtual RGB scan -> common negative-to-positive conversion

digitalConversion.contract: Upstream film exposure/development -> D50 fixed Gaussian RGB transmission; D=-log10(S/S_base), S=sum(D50*Gaussian*10^(-spectral_density)); q=0.184*10^((D-D_gray)/0.60), where D_gray is the same film at linear RGB 0.184; shared channel shoulder q/(0.816+q) -> upstream output gamut compression. No paper, per-film slope/matrix fit, image statistics or automatic exposure. Generic digital positive model; not a measured physical scanner.
digitalConversion.limitation: Film Lab extension, not upstream author output or a measured physical scanner profile.

jpgToneProtection.input: already rendered encoded sRGB / Standard JPEG
jpgToneProtection.neutralAxis: uniform encoded sRGB 0..1; interpolate OKLab response at equal input linear Y
jpgToneProtection.gamutMapping: reduce OKLab chroma at fixed lightness and hue; exact neutral black/white endpoints
limitations: An explicit Film Lab JPEG rendering policy; not unmodified upstream tonality or an official Fujifilm JPEG recipe.
Keeps model colour differences while reducing repeated tonality; gamut-boundary chroma and contrast can change.
Cannot restore source detail already clipped or lost by the camera.

runtimeInitPrintProfile.note: Required only to initialize upstream runtime; printing stages are bypassed and paper is not applied.

adapter.contract: L_STD grid(x) = JpgToneProtection(x, F_VLOG(VLogEncode(sRGBDecode(x) @ sRGB_to_VGamut.T))); F_VLOG is the continuous upstream film stages plus Film Lab digital conversion, not the exported VLOG cube. Native linear input gain = 1.0; no intermediate VLOG LUT interpolation. The display-referred Film Lab protection reduces repeated model tonality, removes neutral casts, bounds coloured-shadow lightness changes and maps chroma into sRGB. This is not an inverse camera profile or unmodified upstream tonality.
adapter.limitation: Analytic working model; does not invert the camera's proprietary Standard rendering.

gamutPolicy: Native colour model retains upstream compression. STD additionally maps OKLab chroma into sRGB at protected lightness and hue. VLOG is unchanged.
preview: Verified LUT-OFF S1M2 Standard JPEGs (resized, color unchanged) and a synthetic sRGB chart -> exported STD LUT directly (tetrahedral) -> sRGB. Not a camera-applied LUT accuracy validation.
